{{dablink|For other uses of the term "''Wheel of Time''," see ''[[Wheel of Time (disambiguation)|Wheel of Time]]''.}}
'''''The Wheel of Time'' FAQ''' was one of the oldest sites dedicated to ''[[The Wheel of Time]]''. It contained various information including explanations of details that may be missed by readers as well as fan theories, some of which may now be obsolete with the release of subsequent books. The site was later moved to [[Dragonmount.com|Dragonmount]] but is no longer available there. A mirror is available or a historical version from 2017 is accessible via the Internet Archive.
